messages:
Mara: Quick sync  need a compact benchmark narrative + inbound routing for the launch. Want visuals that land for PMs and infra.
Priya: Proposal: hero = scatter (median latency vs $/1k), support visuals = cost/latency heatmap by request size, and a waterfall showing batching/cache savings. Fresh angle: show "policy routing" callouts so reliability story visible.
Alex: Love the waterfall idea  helps ops see real unit-econ levers. Headline draft: 'See inference economics by design.' Subhead: 'Tailorable latency and transparent unit costs across deployment modes.'
Sam: I'll export CSV with fields: deployment_mode, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k, tokens_per_req, request_size_bucket. Also produce a small sample script for the demo. ETA EOD.
Noah: Routing rule: AE/Enterprise if Expected_RPS >= 100 OR Compliance includes SOC2/PCI/HIPAA. For RPS 25-99 route to SE/Growth with "white-glove" tag. Tag leads with Preferred_Review (latency|cost|batching). Use SFDC fields: Expected_RPS__c, Compliance_Requirements__c, Preferred_Review__c.
Jen: Webinar format: 30m total  8m claims + 10m demo (show scatter + heatmap + waterfall), 7m technical appendix, 5m Q&A. CTA: 'Run a bench-run  get a tailored latency & cost readout in 48 hours.' Landing form to ask Expected RPS, Avg tokens, Req size, Compliance.
Mara: Agreed. Add a short methodology footnote about token counting and reserved capacity assumptions. Sam: drop the CSV link here when ready and include figma frames.
launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot requested for 2026-09-09 17:00 UTC. Confirm within 48h. :calendar:
Mara: Confirmed. Action items: Sam upload assets, Priya finalize landing copy, Jen build invites, Noah confirm SFDC mapping. Check back with updates here. :thumbsup:
